Credentials are opt-in at creation; only credentials-enabled sessions can have credentials attached later (otherwise 409 `credentials_not_enabled`).

bindings.description: At most 100 bindings. KV references may use { reference, allowedOrigins }, with at most 20 canonical HTTP(S) origins; omitted or empty origins match nothing.

credentialIds.description: Bind the session to these credentials (ids of Secrets of kind `credential` in the session's project). A bound session only ever fills these, never others by namespace and origin. Implies `lookup: "explicit"`. Change them later with /v1/sessions/{id}/credentials. Errors: 400 `credential_not_bindable` (param `credentials.credentialIds`), 400 `too_many_credentials`, 409 `session_id_taken` (a custom sessionId that already has a session or credential bindings).

enabled.description: Set to false to disable credential injection for this session.

exactOrigin.description: Deprecated and ignored: credentials only ever match their own origin or their additionalOrigins.

lookup.description: `implicit` (default without credentialIds or bindings): fill credentials stored for the session's namespace and the page origin. `explicit` (default when credentialIds or bindings is supplied): fill only direct credentials and credentials in bound Vaults, including future members; with none bound, nothing is filled until some are attached.

origins.description: Optional allowlist of credential origins to inject into this session.

debugConfig.description: Configuration for the debug URL and session viewer. Controls interaction capabilities, cursor visibility, and other debug-related settings.

interactive.description: Allow interaction with the browser session via the debug URL viewer. When false, the session viewer will be view-only. Default is true.

systemCursor.description: Show the OS-level mouse cursor in the WebRTC stream (headful mode only). When false, the system cursor will not be rendered in the stream. Default is true.

deviceConfig.description: Device configuration for the session. Specify 'mobile' for mobile device fingerprints and configurations.

dimensions.description: Viewport and browser window dimensions for the session. Mobile sessions require dimensions of at least 508x1074; smaller mobile dimensions are rejected with a 400 response.

experimentalFeatures.description: Enable experimental features for the session.

extensionIds.description: Array of extension IDs to install in the session. Use ['all_ext'] to install all uploaded extensions.

fullscreen.description: Launch the browser in fullscreen mode, covering the full screen with no Chrome UI. Default is false.

headless.description: Enable headless browser mode (disable Headful mode)

inactivityTimeout.description: Inactivity timeout in milliseconds. When set, the session is released if no CDP command or remote input is received for this duration, even if `timeout` has not yet elapsed. Note that `timeout` remains the hard cap on session lifetime: if `inactivityTimeout` is greater than or equal to the effective `timeout`, it has no effect since `timeout` always elapses first. Omit to disable.

metadata.description: Customer-defined flat metadata: up to 50 keys and 8192 UTF-8 JSON bytes. Keys must start with a letter, use only letters, digits, underscores, dots or hyphens, and be at most 64 characters; steel_ is reserved. Values are strings (up to 1024 characters, valid Unicode without NUL), finite numbers or booleans. Numbers and booleans are stored as strings, so 3 and "3" are the same value.
